text: Eduardo's driving test is next Tuesday at 9.40, third attempt. He's pretty nervous about the roundabouts. Text him good luck Monday night.
Yetunde doesn't eat pork and she's off dairy at the moment too, so no cheese board when she comes Saturday
lukas bday 14th nov. into bouldering lately, mentioned wanting new chalk bag
Abigail got her grade 8 piano result back, distinction!! Need to send her flowers this week

so Ravi was saying his sister Elif has her medical school interview in a fortnight and she's absolutely bricking it, um, she's been doing mock ones with their dad every evening. I should message her before it, maybe the night before, just something short
Emeka - coeliac, properly strict. Remember for the curry night.
Julien loves really peaty whisky, Laphroaig type. Birthday is 2 November 2026, could be a good shout

Oisín failed his theory test again yesterday, gutted. Missed it by two on the hazard perception bit. He wants to rebook for early December but the slots near him are all gone so he might have to go to Dundalk. He's living off cereal and energy drinks while he revises, his girlfriend Eilidh is on at him to eat a vegetable. Should check in with him at the weekend and maybe send him that app I used.

Farah's party Friday got cancelled, her mum's not well. Sounds like a chest infection but at her age they're keeping a close eye. Farah's going up to Bradford tomorrow to stay with her for a few days and is a bit all over the place. She'd already bought all the food for the party too, so she's giving it to the neighbours. Check in with her over the weekend, maybe Sunday evening.
Henrik and his wife Sara are doing Dry January early, no booze from this weekend til Christmas apparently
Thomas results day Thursday. A levels. Ask him how it went Thurs eve

Coffee with Ebony. She's vegan now, about two months in, finds eating out a nightmare because half the places near her office only do one sad salad. She's been batch cooking on Sundays instead. Her brother Rhys is doing his bar exam in March 2027 and has basically moved back in with their parents to save money while he revises. She says he's calm on the outside but she can tell he's worried. I should send her that vegan cookbook I keep meaning to lend her.
pick up the cake from the bakery tomorrow before 12, then card shop
Noor turns 30 next Sunday. Her husband Mohammed is planning a surprise dinner at that Lebanese place on the high street. I'm bringing the cake.
eilidh - hates coriander with a passion. also mild nut allergy (not peanuts, tree nuts)
Tadhg is auditioning for the Lyric youth company on the 8th. First audition he's ever done, really nervous but excited. His mum's driving him up to Belfast for it.
note to self: Zofia drinks oat flat whites, no sugar. Adebayo is a black americano guy.
Keisha passed her driving test!!! First time. Congratulate her properly when I see her Wednesday
Kieran's grandad turns 90 on Saturday 7 November 2026, big family do in Galway. Kieran's flying over Friday.
Vikram doing his CFA level 2 in May 2027. Studying every weekend so he'll be quiet til then. Said he's fine but sounded knackered tbh
Carlos is getting really into home espresso, just bought a grinder. Christmas present idea - nice beans from that roaster in Shoreditch

Phone call w Alejandro. His daughter starts her GCSE mocks on Monday, she's been struggling with maths and is a bit of a mess about it. He asked if I know any tutors. Find him a couple of names by Friday.
Aurelio's gluten free now, doctor's orders, not a fad. Pedro said he's been finding it hard
Emily's birthday drinks tonight - wants nothing, but she did say she'd love a new yoga mat, the old one's falling apart

Lunch with Khadija at the Turkish place. She's trying to cut out sugar, again, and had the grilled halloumi and no dessert, very disciplined. Anyway. Her son Tadhg has his 11+ on the 19th, she's more stressed than he is. He seems totally calm about it.
Don't forget to ring Ravi on Thursday, his eye test results came back weird and he's seeing a specialist Friday morning
Abigail Smith - school friend of Ebony's, lives in Leeds, teaches chemistry.
Dentist 3pm Tuesday. Gym after if time.
Elif got into medicine at Edinburgh!! Starts September 2027. Ravi's so proud. Send her a card.

Lukas and his girlfriend Zofia are going to Vienna for her birthday next weekend. They've done the Christmas markets before so it's more of a food trip this time, she wants schnitzel at that place from Before Sunrise lol
Thomas (Tommy to everyone) loves spicy food, the hotter the better. Got a whole shelf of hot sauces. Stocking filler idea - one of those sampler packs
Henrik's oral exam for his Spanish course is on Wednesday. Ask him Thursday how it went
Julien's dog Biscuit has to have his teeth out next week, Julien's weirdly anxious about it
Yetunde's birthday was last Saturday and I totally missed it. Need to send something belated - she mentioned she's into candle making now

right so Mohammed was telling me about his younger brother Vikram who's got his driving test on the 3rd of December, and it's his fourth go, and he's convinced the examiner at that centre has it in for him. Mohammed's taking him out practising every evening this week after work. Apparently he keeps stalling on hill starts. Anyway Mohammed wants us all round for food on the Saturday after, either to celebrate or commiserate. Must remember to keep that day free.
Oisín's mam does the best brown bread. He says she'd give me the recipe if I asked nicely
keisha + emeka anniversary 22 nov, 5 years. they like natural wine, small plates places
Noor's sister Farah is pregnant, due in March 2027. Noor's going to be an auntie for the first time and is buzzing
Remind me Monday to book the restaurant for Carlos's 40th, the one on 12 December 2026
Adebayo's piano recital Sunday afternoon, 3pm at St Luke's. I said I'd go. Taking Eilidh with me.
Kieran doesn't drink at all, never has. Likes those fancy alcohol free beers though, Lucky Saint etc
Sara mentioned she's allergic to shellfish, quite badly. Carries an EpiPen. Henrik usually checks menus for her.

Vikram's mum's 60th is in a fortnight, on the Saturday, and he's totally stuck for ideas. She's into gardening, Bollywood films and anything with mango in it. His dad's organising a lunch for about forty people at a hall near Leicester, and Vikram's sister is doing a slideshow of old photos. He wants to give something from him alone though. Send him that link to the rose subscription thing tonight, and maybe suggest the cinema voucher too.
Did Eduardo pass? Test was this morning, haven't heard anything. Text him tonight if nothing by 6.
Emily and Rhys have their wedding cake tasting on Saturday. Emily can't stand fruitcake so it's sponge all the way. They're thinking lemon and elderflower.
Groceries: oat milk, gluten free pasta, limes, the good hummus. Wine for Friday.

Pedro's son Julien has his black belt grading tomorrow evening. Pedro's more nervous than Julien is honestly. Apparently he's been training four nights a week since the summer and the instructor reckons he's ready, but Pedro hasn't slept properly all week. Their whole family's going to watch, even his abuela. Julien wants pizza afterwards whatever happens, so Pedro's booked the place by the station for 8.

Zofia's into film photography now, she shoots on an old Pentax she found at a car boot sale. Her birthday's 9 March 2027. Film rolls or a lab voucher would go down well, she says developing costs are killing her. Also she's veggie but eats fish, and cannot stand mushrooms.

Long catch-up with Aurelio over dinner. Still at the architecture firm, now leading the hospital project, which sounds stressful but he loves it. Moving flat next month, to Hackney, with his partner Henrik, who I still haven't met. Still eats no red meat, and has gone right off alcohol since the summer, so it was sparkling water all night. He's thinking about doing a part time masters starting January 2027 if work will pay for it. Wants a housewarming once they've unpacked.
Abigail's thesis viva got pushed from Friday to 2 November 2026. She's relieved actually, more time to prep. Ask her afterwards how it went.
Tadhg got the part!! Call him tomorrow and say congrats
Need to start revising for my own driving theory, booked for the 26th. Ugh.
Yetunde's daughter Ebony just found out she's got a place at the Royal Ballet School summer intensive. Starts July 2027. Yetunde cried telling me.
Rhys - lactose intolerant, but fine with hard cheese. Big into board games, especially the long strategy ones. Wingspan fan.
Ebony had her first counselling session on Monday, said it went ok but she's still finding things hard after the breakup. Check in with her next week sometime.
Khadija's husband Alejandro is doing the Valencia marathon in December. She's flying out with the kids to cheer him on. Keeps telling me he's a terrible patient when he's injured lol
Elif's birthday dinner is off - she's got covid. Rescheduling for a fortnight Saturday maybe.

Lukas Schmidt's sitting his German citizenship test next Friday, the 30th. Then Saturday it's his mum's birthday, then Sunday they're driving to Munich for a week. Busy man. I should drop him a good luck text Thursday.
Mohammed's allergic to kiwi of all things. Found out the hard way at Noor's.
nothing much, just a nice walk with Carlos
